spellbook.finance/limitations: The link works for 30 minutes and for this one copy only. expiresAt says when. Fetch a fresh link if the seller comes back later.
Only the seller opens the link. The page takes one front photo, converts it to JPEG and removes location and camera data before it is stored. A new upload replaces the earlier photo.
The photo is public once stored, because eBay loads listing pictures from a public address. currentPhotoUrl shows the photo already on the copy, or null when there is none.

Only the next spellbook_ebay_publish of this copy uses the photo. A listing that is already live on eBay keeps its pictures. To change a live listing, call spellbook_ebay_unpublish for it, then spellbook_ebay_publish again.
For a foil or etched copy the listing keeps catalog art first and shows the seller photo second, so buyers still see the printing's foil art.
Getting the link changes nothing. The seller's upload is the write, and it lists nothing on any marketplace.

annotations.title: Get a photo upload link for one card

description: Get a link where the seller uploads their own phone photo of one inventory copy, so the next eBay listing shows that photo in place of catalog art. Use it when the seller wants buyers to see the real card, or when catalog art is wrong or missing. Take itemId from spellbook_inventory_items_query or spellbook_inventory_holdings. Give the seller the returned url and tell them to open it on their phone, then take or pick a photo of the card front. No photo passes through you. After they say it is saved, call spellbook_ebay_publish for that copy.

itemId.description: One inventory copy's itemId, from spellbook_inventory_items_query or spellbook_inventory_holdings. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that holds the copy. The caller must own it. Required.
